body.html: Teknoppy is an email marketing company in Kochi that turns subscribers into repeat customers with newsletters and automation. Rather than renting attention through ads every time, email consistently delivers among the highest returns of any marketing channel when it's done well.

Choosing the right email marketing agency matters because most businesses treat email as an afterthought — irregular blasts with no segmentation or automation waste an asset that, done properly, keeps generating revenue with almost no ongoing ad spend.

sections.h2: Other digital marketing services in Kochi
Frequently Asked Questions — Email Marketing in Kochi

items.q: How is email marketing different from other digital marketing channels?
items.a: Email reaches subscribers who already opted in and know your business, giving it higher engagement and lower ongoing cost than channels where you're competing for attention among strangers, like paid ads or social feeds.

items.q: Do you set up automated sequences, or just send one-off campaigns?
items.a: Both. Email automation services handle recurring flows like welcome series and nurture sequences, while one-off campaigns cover promotions, announcements, and newsletters as needed.

items.q: How often should we send emails?
items.a: Typically 2 to 4 newsletters a month plus automated event triggers. Consistency and value matter far more than spamming inboxes.

items.q: Why do our emails go to spam?
items.a: Emails usually land in spam due to missing domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), poor list hygiene with high bounce rates, or sending to unverified addresses. We set up full authentication and clean your list before sending.

items.q: Can you work with our existing Mailchimp, Brevo or Klaviyo account?
items.a: Yes. We work inside your existing account in Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, Zoho Campaigns, or HubSpot, connecting it directly to your website or CRM.

items.q: How do we know if email marketing is actually working?
items.a: We judge email by clicks, conversions and revenue per send, tracked with UTM tags in GA4. Open rates are a rough signal only, because privacy features in many inboxes inflate them.

items.q: Can you help recover lost sales from abandoned carts?
items.a: Yes. Abandoned cart email automation is one of the highest-ROI sequences we build for ecommerce clients, automatically reminding shoppers who left items in their cart.

items.q: Do you design the email templates too?
items.a: Yes. Responsive email template design ensures every campaign looks professional and renders correctly across mobile, tablet, and desktop inboxes.
